displayName: Whole Foods Grocery Data API - Store Prices, Prime Deals, Sales Flyer
description: Whole Foods Market grocery data as structured JSON - search and browse the catalog of the store you choose with that store's shelf prices (regular, sale and Prime member price, with sale dates), list every product on sale at a store, read one product with ingredients, nutrition facts, diets and its in-store and online prices side by side, find stores near a ZIP, read one store's details, and pull its weekly sales flyer. 7 endpoints, 1 credit each.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
